items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: I went to the club for 15 months. Billy Miller, yeah.

ctx.x: Then he had another one called Nice Boy. That other? Nice Boy. He had a fellow like Billy Miller around here years ago, that featured sweet violets.

I don't know why I bless him, but I heard sweet violets. Yeah. I went to the club for 15 months. Billy Miller, yeah. The bass player? See I could, no he was the singer, comedian. Oh Billy. Comedian, yeah. Yeah.
Not Teddy Miller's brother. What? He's no kid to Teddy Miller.
